title: Ribosome Profiling of Drosophila Third Instar Larvae Body Wall Muscle
author: Xun Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j89crz6
materials: gel elution buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 250 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA)
Extract RNA with 500 µl Trizol (15596026, ThermoFisher Scientific), precipitate RNA with 5 µl linear acrylamide (AM9520, ThermoFisher Scientific), dissolve pellet in 7 µl nuclease-free water.

Rotate the tube at 4 °C overnight. Transfer eluate with gel pieces to a gel filter (CLS8162, Sigma-Aldrich) and centrifuge at 16000g for 5 min at 25 °C. Transfer the cleared eluate to a new 1.7 ml centrifuge tube.

Next Generation Sequencing Library generation: Perform Phosphatase treatment by combining 15 µl Gel purified RFs, 10 µl 5XrSAP buffer (20 mM Tris, PH 8.0, 250 mM NaCl, 1 mM MgCl2), 2.5 µl rSAP (M0371S, NEB), 2.5 µl SUPERase.In (AM2696, ThermoFisher Scientific), 20 µl Nuclease-free water in a PCR tube. Mix and then incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Tissue Collection and Freezing
steps.instruction: Drive expression of RpL3-3xFlag using a muscle driver (BG57>UAS-RpL3-3XFlag). Pick wandering 3rd instar larvae and dissect in HL3 to collect body wall tissue (internal organs removed). Immediately place tissue in a 1.7ml centrifuge tube and freeze on dry ice.

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Protein Extraction
steps.instruction: Collect 8 body walls per sample in one tube. Add 240 µl lysis buffer (10 mM HEPES, PH 7.4, 150 mM KCl, 5 mM MgCl2, 100 µg/ml Cycloheximide, 1X protease inhibitor (EDTA-free, Sigma, COEDTAF-RO), 1U/µl ANTI-RNase (ThermoFisher scientific, AM2690)).

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly grind tissue using pellet pestles (Z359971, Sigma-Aldrich).
Add 12 µl 10% TritonX-100.
Rotate the tube at 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Lysate Clarification
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 4 °C, 15000g for 10 min to clear the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Ribosome Capture and RNase T1 Digestion
steps.instruction: Coat 100 µl magnetic beads (10004D, ThermoFisher Scientific) with 4 µg of anti-Flag antibody (F1804, Sigma-Aldrich).

substeps.instruction: Mix cleared lysate with the beads.
Add 10µl RNase T1 (EN0542, ThermoFisher Scientific).
Rotate the mixture at 4 °C for 6 hours.

steps.title: Bead Washing
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnet and discard all liquid.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads with 200 µl wash buffer (10 mM HEPES, PH 7.4, 150 mM KCl, 5 mM MgCl2, 100 µg/ml Cycloheximide, 0.1% Triton-X100, 0.1 U/µl SUPERase.in RNase Inhibitor (ThermoFisher scientific, AM2696)) by pipetting up and down ~10 times.
Perform a total of three washes, then discard all liquid.

steps.title: RNA Sample Preparation and Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Mix the RNA sample with 2XTBE urea sample buffer (LC6876, ThermoFisher Scientific).

substeps.instruction: Heat the mixture at 70 °C for 2 min, then immediately place on ice.
Run the sample on a 15% TBE-Urea PAGE gel with 30nt and 50 nt DNA oligo markers for 90 min at 200 V.
Stain the gel with SYBR Green II RNA gel stain (S7564, ThermoFisher Scientific, 1X in TBE buffer) for 15 min.

steps.title: Ribosome Footprint Gel Extraction
steps.instruction: View gel under a transilluminator and cut the region corresponding to 30 nt to 50 nt (based on oligo markers). Place the gel piece in a 1.7 ml centrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl gel elution buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, PH 7.5, 250 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA).
Crush gel with pellet pestle.
Add another 300 µl gel elution buffer, 22 µl RNAsecure (AM7005, ThermoFisher Scientific), and 5 µl 20% SDS.
Mix well and heat at 60 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation and Purification
steps.instruction: Perform RNA precipitation by adding 500 µl isopropanol and 7 µl linear acrylamide to the tube and mixing well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 15000g at 25 °C for 15 min.
Wash the pellet with 75% ethanol once, discard liquid, and air dry the pellet for 5 min.
Dissolve the pellet in 16 µl nuclease-free water.

steps.title: rSAP Inactivation
steps.instruction: Add 2 µl RNAsecure and 0.5 µl EDTA (500 mM) to the sample.

substeps.instruction: Mix and heat at 65 °C for 10 min to inactivate rSAP.

steps.title: Secondary RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl isopropanol, mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15000g at 4 °C for 10 min.
Wash pellet with 75% ethanol, discard liquid, and air dry pellet for 5 min.
Dissolve the pellet in 7 µl Nuclease-free water.

steps.title: 3' Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform 3’ adaptor ligation using NEBNext Mµltiplex Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina (E7300S, NEB).

substeps.instruction: Mix 6 µl phosphatase treated RNA and 1 µl 3’ SR Adaptor for Illumina.
Heat at 70 °C for 2 minutes, then immediately transfer to ice.
Add 10 µl 3’ Ligation Reaction Buffer and 3 µl 3’ Ligation Enzyme Mix; mix well.
Incubate at 25 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Kinase Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µl ATP (10 mM), 1.5 µl DTT (50 mM), and 0.5 µl T4 PNK (M0201S, NEB) to the 3’ ligation reaction.

substeps.instruction: Mix and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription Primer Hybridization
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl SR RT Primer for Illumina (M0201S, NEB) to the T4 PNK reaction and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Heat the sample for 5 min at 75 °C.
Allow the sample to slowly cool down in the thermocycler until the temperature drops below 35 °C.

steps.title: 5' SR Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform 5’ SR adaptor ligation using NEBNext Mµltiplex Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina (E7300S, NEB).

substeps.instruction: Add 1µl denatured 5’ SR Adaptor for Illumina, 1 µl 5’ Ligation Reaction Buffer, and 2.5 µl Ligation Enzyme Mix to the hybridization reaction; mix well.
Incubate at 25 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription using NEBNext Mµltiplex Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina (E7300S, NEB).

substeps.instruction: Add 8 µl First Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer, 1 µl Murine RNase Inhibitor, and 1 µl ProtoScript II Reverse Transcriptase to the 5’ SR adaptor ligation reaction; mix well.
Incubate at 50 °C for 60 min.

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification (15 cycles) using NEBNext Mµltiplex Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina (E7300S, NEB).

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl LongAmp Tag 2X Master Mix, 2.5 µl SR Primer for Illumina, 2.5 µl Index Primer, and 5 µl Nuclease free water to the reverse transcription reaction; mix well.
Run PCR cycling: 94 °C 30 sec, then 15 cycles of [94 °C 15 sec, 62 °C 30 sec, 70 °C 15 sec], then 70 °C 5 min, hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: PCR Product Purification
steps.instruction: To the 100 µl PCR product, add 3 µl linear acrylamide, 10 µl NaCl (2.5 M), and 100 µl Isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Mix well and incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 15000g at 4 °C for 10 min.
Wash the pellet with 75% ethanol once, discard liquid, and air dry the pellet for 5 min.
Dissolve the pellet in 10 µl nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Library Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform size selection using NEBNext Mµltiplex Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina (E7300S, NEB).

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µl PCR product with 2 µl Gel Loading Dye, Blue.
Run on 6% PAGE gel with 5 µl of Quick-Load pBR322 for 1 hour at 120 V.
Stain the gel with SYBR Gold nucleic acid gel stain (S11494, ThermoFisher Scientific, 1X in TBE buffer) for 15 min.

steps.title: Library Gel Extraction
steps.instruction: View gel under a transilluminator and cut the region corresponding to 140 bp to 170 bp (based on Quick-Load pBR322 markers). Place the gel piece in a 1.7 ml centrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl gel elution buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, PH 7.5, 250 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA).
Crush gel with pellet pestle.
Add another 300 µl gel elution buffer and 5 µl 20% SDS.
Mix well and rotate the tube at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Eluate Filtration
steps.instruction: Transfer eluate with gel pieces to a gel filter (CLS8162, Sigma-Aldrich).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16000g for 5 min at 25 °C.
Transfer the cleared eluate to a new 1.7 ml centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Final DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform DNA precipitation by adding 500 µl isopropanol and 5 µl linear acrylamide to the tube and mixing well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 15000g at 25 °C for 15 min.
Wash the pellet with 75% ethanol once, discard liquid, and air dry the pellet for 5 min.
Dissolve the pellet in 15 µl nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Sequencing Submission
steps.instruction: Submit the library sample for next-generation sequencing on an Illumina platform or store at -20 °C.
